name: OpenLIT
summary: Open-source, OpenTelemetry-native platform for AI agents: tracing, evals, guardrails, prompt hub, vault, and cost and GPU monitoring; self-host free.
description: Traces every LLM call, tool call, MCP request and retrieval via OpenTelemetry SDKs (`pip install openlit` / `npm install openlit`), evaluates on real traces (LLM-as-a-judge, programmatic, human feedback, CI gates), adds runtime guardrails (prompt injection, sensitive or restricted topics) and manages prompts and secrets without redeploying. Tracks cost (incl. custom pricing) and NVIDIA/AMD/Intel GPUs. Self-host with `docker compose up -d`.
